briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-3 and xAI Grok-4 race intensifies multi-agent capabilities

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid escalating compute investments. Multi-agent systems emerge as the dominant paradigm with new safety challenges. Funding remains robust despite regulatory scrutiny.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-3 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google unveils Gemini 3 Ultra; Meta open-sources Llama 4; xAI ships Grok-4; DeepSeek launches V3. Multi-agent orchestration drives performance gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, IoT and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC capacity deals; Microsoft and Google expand data center builds in Texas and Arizona; xAI completes Memphis Phase 2 supercluster.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems by end of 2026?
